requirements.statement: M16 node-to-node supervision shall use a contract distinct from Guardian Protocol v0.1 host/device command semantics.
Successful node authentication shall not directly grant physical actuation authority.
Within one initialized runtime session, NodeLink shall reject duplicate or regressing sequence values.
Loss of the supervisory link shall resolve through a deterministic bounded local state and shall not silently increase authority.
Disagreement between the STM32F401 node and the NXP supervisory node shall not silently grant unilateral authority to either node.
NodeLink core semantics shall remain independent of UART, SPI, CAN, CAN-FD or other physical transport adapters.
NodeLink CRC integrity shall not be represented as cryptographic authentication.
Host validation of M16 NodeLink shall not be promoted to evidence of physical dual-node hardware behavior.
